# gws recipe: Review Meet attendance

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the review-meet-participants recipe: review who attended a Google Meet conference and for how long — list conference records, list participants, drill into participant sessions — in 3 commands. No equivalent in lots 31-33: it teaches the conference-records audit, data few people know how to extract, and it's the read-only counterpart of `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-create-meet-space` in this lot (audit after vs creation before). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
